reason: I'm not spending money on an all-in-one app until I know it isn't bloated and laggy between gym sets, especially when the core workout logging and RPG stat titles are already free.
objection: Apps trying to do lifting, 30+ sports, social feeds, and nutrition all at once almost always end up bloated and too slow for logging quick sets on the gym floor.
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free version and finding out the set-logging UI is lightning fast with zero clutter, plus seeing deeper RPG skill trees and character builds in Pro.
